stock.description: Beijing Digital Telecom Co., Ltd. operates as a diversified telecommunications enterprise, primarily engaged in the retail and distribution of mobile devices and their accessories, complemented by a comprehensive suite of related services. The company's market reach spans Mainland China, Spain, Bangladesh, India, Romania, and Bulgaria. It employs a multi-channel sales approach, utilizing its own independent stores and shop-in-shop setups, collaborations with mobile carriers, online sales portals, and supplies to its franchisee network. Additionally, Beijing Digital Telecom serves as a distributor of mobile communication equipment and peripherals to mobile network operators and various third-party retailers. Beyond sales, the company delivers management services to product suppliers, provides value-added software solutions, and offers critical repair, maintenance, personalized, and after-sales support for mobile phones. It also leases counter space to external entities for repair provisions. Furthermore, the company is involved in the research, development, and manufacturing of telecommunication devices and accessories. By December 31, 2021, its extensive retail footprint within China included approximately 800 company-owned and franchised outlets across 22 provinces and 4 municipalities. Founded in 1993, the company maintains its headquarters in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
